snippet.title: LIVORA - Every Choice Has a Cost | Life Sim Game on Steam
snippet.description:
LIVORA is a life simulation game where rent, work, bills, messages, relationships, energy and future consequences all shape the life you build.

Every choice has a cost. Not every cost is money.

Build a life. Survive the cost.

Play LIVORA now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4841780/LIVORA/
